preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 2000.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 2000, a must be between 1 and n, and b must be between 1 and the minimum of 26 and a.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n and all(len(set(s[i:i+a])) == b for i in range(n-a+1)) for s in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output string s must have length n, and every substring of length a must contain exactly b distinct letters.
